messages:
FinanceOps: Reconciliation flagged a weird combo: consolidated billing move last month appears to have routed partner sustained credits to `consolidated-host` while a simultaneous failover generated an orphan GPU surge (~$21.4k). We need attribution + provisional ledger entries before EOD. :rotating_light:
cloud-ops: dataset is billing_view.gcp_billing_export_v1_88888. Running a split-by-project + credit query now.
FinanceOps: thank you. Example SQL we use to compare credits vs usage by project:
```sql
SELECT project_id, SUM(cost) AS usage_cost, SUM(credit_amount) AS credits
FROM `billing_view.gcp_billing_export_v1_88888.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-05' AND sku_description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY project_id
ORDER BY usage_cost DESC;
```
cloud-ops: quick output: research-sandbox usage $13.2k credits $0; partner-consumption credits $10k usage $0; ai-prototyping usage $8.2k credits $0. Consolidated-host got the $10k.
anil: research-sandbox is on my team. We also had a regional controller failover in us-central1 -> europe-west1 which caused duplicate runs for ~4m with 16 GPUs active. That explains the orphan chunk.
eng-sre: confirming logs: controller leader-election missed a heartbeat and started a fresh run in europe-west1 while original pods in us-central1 were not cleanly terminated. Overlap window 4.2 minutes. That duplication accounts for $11.4k of the total. The remaining $10k appears to be sustained credits applied to consolidated-host.
FinanceOps: action items: 1) provisional internal allocation of the $11.4k duplicate charge to research-sandbox, 2) provisional reallocation of the $10k sustained credit across top GPU consumers (ai-prototyping, research-sandbox, infra-test) pending vendor case, 3) open vendor dispute referencing the consolidated-host misapplication.
cloud-ops: I can generate GPU-hours for May to prorate the $10k. Quick query:
```sql
SELECT project_id, SUM(usage_amount) as gpu_hours
FROM `billing_view.gcp_billing_export_v1_88888.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_month='2026-05' AND sku_description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY project_id
ORDER BY gpu_hours DESC;
```
cloud-ops: gpu-hours: ai-prototyping 520, research-sandbox 330, infra-test 50 (others small). Total major = 900 hrs.
FinanceOps: prorate $10k: ai-prototyping $5,777, research-sandbox $3,667, infra-test $556 (rounded). I'll create provisional ledger entries: PROV-248750-A (duplicate-run $11,400 to research-sandbox) and PROV-248750-B (credit allocation splits).
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-4499 created: "Provisional allocation + vendor dispute: consolidated credits landing on host + duplicate regional runs". Assignee: cloud-ops. SLA: 7 business days.
vendor-liaison: I'll open vendor case VND-912 with acme-cloud-billing@vendor.example and attach invoice INV-GCP-2026-1322 and the BigQuery outputs. We should include terraform commit that changed billing mapping (commit 1a2b3c on 2026-04-11) as evidence of intent.
anil: I'll own the retrocharge for the duplicate-run amount and open JOB-721 to harden controller singleton semantics and add an immediate kill-switch for overlap > 60s.
eng-sre: I'll add a billing detection rule: if same trace_id appears in >1 region within 15m, auto-alert and create provisional charge entry. Also adding a pre-deploy gating step that enforces cost-center tags for heavy GPU jobs.
product-ops: we should also update the procurement checklist so consolidated billing moves require explicit mapping and a post-bill verification step during the first invoice after migration.
FinanceOps: agreed. I'll post the provisional ledger entries and tag them VND-912 / BILL-4499. If vendor reassigns credits to consumers, we'll reverse PROV-248750-B and update budgets. If vendor declines, credits remain corporate and we keep the provisional splits.
cloud-ops: attaching quick commands I used to investigate instances:
```bash
gcloud compute instances list --filter='labels:gpu AND name~research' --format='table(name,zone,status)'
```
FinanceOps: thanks everyone. Closing thread; follow BILL-4499 and VND-912 for updates. Ping here if you need changes to the provisional entries. :white_check_mark:
